title: Spare cells beat unknown moves

audio_alignment.method: Central waveform correlation after mono 8kHz decoding; encoding delay allowed. Not listening.

scope: A concrete pairing defence, cube lines, Hall matching, surplus and deletion robustness, central and noncentral openings, the opposite-octant correction, and the six-cube obstruction. This is a new short proof of the known seven-cube theorem. Six-cube and five-cube remain open; Lean covers the abstract lemmas, not the actual board enumeration or whole game.
